name: brain
notes: Run npm ci && npm run build and cargo build --release -p brain-server --bin brain -p brain-env-worker --bin brain-env-worker before measuring.
Uses the real upstream Pi harness selected at startup. Previous measurements used a different loop and are not comparable. New performance claims require rerunning the probes.

cold_start.definition: process launch on a fresh data directory until the first turn is served; one-time installation untimed

recovery.definition: kill -9 after 50 turns, relaunch on the same data, until the same session serves a turn whose model request carries its history

create.definition: POST /v1/sessions until the response carries a session_id, startup harness ready

idle.definition: private memory across the whole process tree with no sessions created, sampled for 20s after 10s of settling; the figure a project README calls "idle memory"

ttfb.definition: message submitted until the first assistant_delta frame on its SSE stream; the stream is opened before the message is sent, so the client’s own subscribe latency is outside the measurement

round_trip.definition: POST /v1/sessions/{id}/messages until the response returns, one complete text turn

throughput.definition: complete text turns per second across N concurrent sessions, unpaced

resident.definition: Private_Clean + Private_Dirty + Private_Hugetlb across the brain and loop-worker tree, held minus post-discard, per session

reclaim.definition: share of private memory returned after deleting every session, then settling

persistence.definition: bytes on disk in the session data directory after N turns of one conversation, sampled per turn; Brain appends a record per turn and rewrites session state in place
